name: Neural Draft
description: The backend for sites built with AI: CMS, blog, bookings, forms, shop and social, one database per client. Your coding assistant reads the brand, creates pages with SEO meta and registers editable content keys and components; clients edit in a web editor or through Claude.
author: Neural Draft

NEURALDRAFT_API_KEY.description: Workspace API key (ndsk_live_…) from the Neural Draft admin: Settings → For developers → API keys. Not needed when NEURALDRAFT_API_KEYS is set.

NEURALDRAFT_API_KEYS.description: Several workspaces in one server (agencies): client-a=ndsk_live_…,client-b=ndsk_live_… or a JSON object. Switch with list_workspaces and switch_workspace.

NEURALDRAFT_WORKSPACE.description: Which workspace from NEURALDRAFT_API_KEYS is active at start (default: the first).

NEURALDRAFT_API_URL.description: API base URL override. Defaults to https://api.neuraldraft.io/v1.
